events.title: Abbey Road released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: On this day in 1969, The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That iconic cover and those timeless tracks – still sounds incredible today.

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 today. A true legend whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' lead singer Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Bday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde of The Pretenders. Still rocking it with that unmistakable voice and attitude.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Bday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the swagger and those anthems.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album, Imagine, was released in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Release
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon released his seminal album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the first iPod, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 and over six decades of iconic films, gadgets, and unforgettable theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have been 86 today.

angles.name: John Lennon Bday
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. A musical genius whose legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Bday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The White Album released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Release
angles.copy: On this day in 1968, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that pushed boundaries.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing. His incredible talent and unforgettable performances live on.

events.title: Rubber Soul released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, Rubber Soul, in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Release
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showcased their evolving sound and lyrical depth.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on the anniversary of his passing. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.
